candidate_selection: For each track, among development-gate passers choose lowest pooled MdAPE; tie-break on pooled MAPE, then fixed candidate order. Final results cannot change selection.
holdout_policy: Development runner reads only listing records sold before 2025-04-01. Do not load final-month labels until a manifest locks a passing candidate for both tracks. Final fold fits only after freeze. Never inspect hidden test labels.
baseline_policy: Re-fit every v2 C0 learner inside each fold using only sales strictly before that held-out month. List-aware C0 is the locked LightGBM challenger blended at 0.75 with an HGBR log-sale-price model; round HGBR before blending and round the final price.
thread_policy: At most four threads and one learner fit at a time.
